metadata.description: Jupiter and Saturn sign, nakshatra, and navamsa transition reference data extracted from the supplied Excel workbook.
metadata.note: Only Jupiter and Saturn transition labels and their corresponding dates/times are included. Other planets and unrelated workbook columns are excluded. Duplicate Jupiter sign transition at 2000-06-02 20:12 IST (Taurus (2)) was deduplicated; the first occurrence (Excel row 80) was retained and the second (Excel row 81) removed.
